about_the_game:
When the night grows deep and the world looks away, a Dogaby rises.

Moonlit Reaper is a stage-based action RPG where you become a young Dogaby, stepping into forsaken lands to hunt those consumed by darkness. Wielding powerful weapons, ancient spells, and the will to rise again, you must cut through the hordes before your enemies vanish into the dark.

Blending fast-paced hack and slash action, strategic base defense, and roguelite progression, Moonlit Reaper drives your will to the edge, in a world where you collect and forge powerful weapons, unlock hidden skills, and shape your path through each hard-fought run.

Core Features:

  • Isometric Hack and Slash Combat
    Engage in real-time combat, wielding magical attacks to crush your enemies. Move with WASD, deliver powerful strikes, and unleash devastating skills in a dance of focus and fury.

  • Stage-Based Roguelite Progression
    Survive increasingly intense waves of enemies and adapt to challenging stages. With each fall, you rise stronger — carrying lessons, newfound strength, and hard-earned upgrades into your next challenge. No defeat is wasted, and every run forges your path forward.

  • Transcendence System
    Upon defeat or at will, transcend to return to the beginning. Bring back your most treasured weapons, permanent upgrades, and a portion of collected soul shards into your next challenge.

  • Base Defense with Tactical Depth
    Hold back enemy forces and seal them within battlefields as you prevent darkness from slipping away. Every decision matters — when to push forward, when to fall back, and how to survive. Because once the enemies break through, the world is condemned by darkness.

  • Collect and Upgrade Weapons, Skills, and Strength
    Discover a wide variety of melee and magical weapons, support items, and gear. Upgrade weapons and stats, unlock powerful new skills as you progress, and build your own unique combat style.

  • Face Unique Bosses and Malevolent Beings
    Battle against animals sworn to darkness, people claimed by shadow, and evil born from pure malice. Each enemy presents a distinct presence and challenge, leading to unforgettable encounters.

  • Emotional Narrative with Heartfelt Characters
    Be welcomed by villagers who cheer your first steps as a Dogaby, meet companions who guide and support your journey, and face enemies burdened by sorrow and anguish. Every soul has a reason to fight — or a reason to regret.

  • Random Events and Encounters
    Use Action Points between stages to seek out unexpected encounters. Meet wandering strangers, make hard choices, and experience fleeting moments of mystery, humor, or risk.

  • Village: Upgrade, Converse, and Grow
    Between battles, return to the village to rest and prepare. Upgrade your stats and skills, visit shops, speak with unique NPCs, and uncover the many layers of this living, breathing world.

Whether you're here for the thrill of battle, the quiet stories in-between, or both, Moonlit Reaper invites you into a world that never stops breathing. Here, every moment fuels your spirit. Every fight forges your legacy. And every end is only the beginning.

name: Moonlit Reaper

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 500 series
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Where lost souls drift and silence screams, you walk alone beneath the moonlight toward shadows of pure malice. Reap those beyond redemption. Collect weapons and skills. Grow strength from each fall. In this roguelite action, you are the Moonlit Reaper — not a hero, but a promise kept in moonlight.
